DeggCropImage.description: Crop any part of the image or extend the frame outside its borders.

mask.name: Mask
mask.tooltip: Optional alpha for the source (1 = opaque). Replaces the source alpha.

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect ratio
aspect_ratio.tooltip: Frame aspect ratio. Inactive while Lock Ratio is off.

lock_ratio.name: Lock ratio
lock_ratio.tooltip: Keep the selected aspect ratio while dragging.

dim_outside.name: Dim outside (%)
dim_outside.tooltip: Display only: darken the area outside the frame.

multiplicity.name: Multiplicity
multiplicity.tooltip: Round the output width and height to this step.

megapixels.name: Megapixels
megapixels.tooltip: Output area budget in megapixels (1 MP = 1,000,000 px).

resample.name: Resampling
resample.tooltip: Resampling filter used when the frame is rescaled.

fill.name: Fill outside
fill.tooltip: Color of the area outside the source image.

crop_rect.name: Crop rectangle
crop_rect.tooltip: Internal: normalized crop rectangle, written by the node UI.
